name: 2D Fan-beam Reconstruction
definition: A reconstruction algorithm for 2D data where X-ray paths diverge from a source, mapped to parallel-beam formulas via geometric Jacobian.
summary: 2D Fan-beam Reconstruction is an analytic algorithm that reconstructs a 2D density field from diverging X-ray projections by mapping ray paths to parallel-beam integrals and applying filtered backprojection, explicitly accounting for source-to-detector divergence.
